models.name: github__issues
models.description: Each record represents a github issue. Only considering issues that are not pull request

columns.name: issue_id
columns.description: The unique ID of an issue.

columns.name: body
columns.description: The text body of the issue's main description

columns.name: closed_at
columns.description: The timestamp for when an issue was last closed.  "null" for issues that are open

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: The timestamp for when an issue was created

columns.name: is_locked
columns.description: Boolean indicating if the issue is locked.

columns.name: issue_number
columns.description: The number of the issue.  Is unique within a repository, but not across repositories.

columns.name: is_pull_request
columns.description: Boolean indicating whether the issue is a pull request

columns.name: repository_id
columns.description: Foreign key that references the repository table

columns.name: state
columns.description: Whether the issue is open or closed

columns.name: title
columns.description: The title of the issue

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the issue was last updated

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key that references the user table, representing the user who created the issue.

columns.name: number_of_times_reopened
columns.description: Total number of times the issue was reopened.

columns.name: number_of_comments
columns.description: The total number of comments included in the issue

columns.name: repository
columns.description: The full name of the repository that the issue is applicable to

columns.name: repository_team_names
columns.description: Aggregate of the teams associated with the repository, formed by concatenating team names in ascending alphabetical order, separated by a comma and space.

columns.name: creator_login_name
columns.description: The alias of the user uses to login to github who created the issue.

columns.name: creator_name
columns.description: The name of the user who created the issue.

columns.name: creator_company
columns.description: The company of the user who created the issue.

models.name: github__pull_requests
models.description: Basic information about pull_requests as well as additional fields about reviews and time between actions

columns.name: issue_id
columns.description: The unique ID of an issue.

columns.name: body
columns.description: the text body of the description of the pull request

columns.name: closed_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the pull request was closed.  NULL for pull requests that are still open

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the pull request was created

columns.name: is_locked
columns.description: Boolean indicating whether the issue is locked.

columns.name: issue_number
columns.description: The number of the issue.  Is unique within a repository, but not across repositories

columns.name: is_pull_request
columns.description: Boolean indiciating whether the issue is a pull request.

columns.name: repository_id
columns.description: Foreign key that references the repository table

columns.name: state
columns.description: Whether the pull request is open or closed.

columns.name: title
columns.description: The title of the pull request

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the issue was last updated

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key that references the user table.

columns.name: number_of_times_reopened
columns.description: Total number of times the issue was reopened

columns.name: number_of_comments
columns.description: The total number of comments included in the issue

columns.name: repository
columns.description: The full name of the repository that the pull request applies to

columns.name: repository_team_names
columns.description: Aggregate of the teams associated with the repository, formed by concatenating team names in ascending alphabetical order, separated by a comma and space.

columns.name: creator_login_name
columns.description: The alias of the user uses to login to github who created the issue.

columns.name: creator_name
columns.description: The name of the user who created the issue.

columns.name: creator_company
columns.description: The company of the user who created the issue.

columns.name: merged_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the pull request was merged

columns.name: reviewers
columns.description: Aggregate of the distinct users who reviewed the pull request, formed by concatenating reviewer names in ascending alphabetical order, separated by a comma and space.

columns.name: number_of_reviews
columns.description: Number of times a pull request was reviewed

models.name: github__daily_metrics
models.description: Summary numbers for issues and pull requests per repository by day

columns.name: day
columns.description: The reporting day

columns.name: repository
columns.description: The full name of the repository

columns.name: number_issues_opened
columns.description: The total number of issues created during this time period. Set to 0 if no issues were created.

columns.name: number_issues_closed
columns.description: The total number of issues closed during this time period. Set to 0 if no issues were closed.

columns.name: number_prs_opened
columns.description: The total number of pull requests created during this time period. Set to 0 if no pull requests were created.

columns.name: number_prs_merged
columns.description: The total number of pull requests merged during this time period. Set to 0 if no pull requests were merged.

columns.name: number_prs_closed_without_merge
columns.description: The total number of pull requests closed without a merge during this time period. Set to 0 if no pull requests were closed without a merge.

    files_definition_id: 778daa7c-feaf-4db6-96f3-70fd645acc77
    mongodb_definition_id: b2e713cd-cc36-4c0a-b5bd-b47cb8a0561e
    namespace_definition: destination

    databricks_definition_id: 072d5540-f236-4294-ba7c-ade8fd918496
aws_s3:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: test
  AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-west-2
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: http://elt-localstack:4566
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: test
  data:
  - path: s3://github-bucket/repo_team.jsonl
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    table: repo_team
custom_api:
  config:
    configuration: {}
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - issue_assignee
    - issue_merged
    - repository
flat_files:
- format: jsonl
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1eIhuDa2LRFfkKVbgdjRYWV6uv83MH0W0
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: requested_reviewer_history
- format: csv
  path: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1UqPqN9whWn9OkRKQnNHFVreQYvlGC154
  sync_mode: full_refresh_append
  table: issue_label
mongodb:
  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    database: github
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - issue_comment
    - label
    - pull_request_review
    - team
postgres:
  config:
    database: github
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - issue
    - issue_closed_history
    - pull_request
    - users
    user: postgres
databricks:
  config:
    database: <db_database>
    hostname: <db_hostname>
    client_id: <db_client_id>
    secret: <db_secret>
    schema: github
    http_path: <db_path>
